parameters.content:
## GRC alerts: findings to Slack or Teams
1. Edit **Settings**: paste a Slack incoming webhook address (or a Teams workflow address that accepts `{"text": ...}`) and your GRC address.
2. Activate this workflow and copy the **Production URL** of the *Finding webhook* node.
3. In the GRC platform open **Automation**, open *Send new findings to n8n or Zapier (template)*, paste that URL into its *Call webhook* step, switch it on and save.
Only findings at or above *minimum_severity* are posted. No personal data is sent.
